# INV-USD-001 of `fx_usd_invoice_cad_income.txt`, paid 100.00 USD from the CAD bank.
#
# The invoice is booked at 1.40 CAD/USD, and the bank gives 137.00 CAD for the
# 100.00 USD, so the settlement converts the whole receivable and draws 100.00
# USD out of the posting split's cost basis. The 3.00 CAD between the two is
# the `$residual$` line.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_converting_settlement_needs_the_cost_basis_it_draws_on.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		settled_amount: 137.00
		memo: "Payment"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
